title: TUI job queue, Ingest/Fact-check workbench, parent/child chunking

questions.prompt: What happens to the 45,729 existing flat clauses (193 documents), which have no parent?
questions.description: New ingest runs will write parent_chunks and children that carry a parent_id. The existing rows came from the old StructuralCoherenceChunker.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep them and tag them as a 'legacy' chunk_run (parent_id NULL). The Ingest mode lists legacy runs under their own label. Re-ingesting a notebook creates a new run; it never deletes legacy rows automatically.

options.label: Keep them as a 'legacy' run; re-ingest per notebook when needed
Backfill: group legacy clauses into synthetic parents by document order
Delete them and re-ingest the whole archive

questions.prompt: Which controls does the Jobs tab need?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Cancel a running or queued job, retry a failed or interrupted job, clear finished jobs, and filter the list by kind/status.

options.label: Cancel (queued: removed; running: cooperative stop at the next item)
Retry failed/interrupted jobs (failed items only, or the whole job)
Clear finished jobs from the list
Filter by kind / status
Reorder or prioritize queued jobs
Pause/resume the whole queue

questions.prompt: How long do finished job records stay in Redis?
questions.recommendedAnswer: 7 days, using an EXPIRE set on each nblm:job:* key when the job finishes. Durable results (assets, chunks, verdicts) are already in Postgres or on disk.

options.label: 1 day
7 days
30 days
Until cleared manually

questions.prompt: How should jobs appear in Langfuse?
questions.description: Tracing currently goes through OpenTelemetry using the openinference DSPy instrumentor to Langfuse at tinybot:3000.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Each job opens one root OTel span named job.<kind> carrying the attributes job_id, notebook_id and chunk_run_id. DSPy calls nest under it. The trace id is stored on the job record, on chunk_runs and on fact_checks, and the TUI shows a link to it. Download jobs are traced too, so failures can be found in Langfuse.

options.label: One root span per job; LLM/DSPy calls nested under it
Persist the trace id on job, chunk_runs and fact_checks rows
Show the trace URL in the Jobs and Fact-check detail panes
Trace non-LLM jobs (download, ingest) as well
One child span per chunk/item (more detail, more volume)

questions.prompt: How should ClusterSemanticChunker set its breakpoint threshold?
questions.description: It embeds each atomic sentence produced by the recursive splitter with embeddinggemma (768-dimensional) and groups adjacent sentences while their similarity stays above a threshold.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A percentile of adjacent cosine distances within the document (default 90th percentile = break), with min/max child size bounds. It reuses the sentence embeddings for the stored children, so it needs no second embedding pass.

options.label: Per-document percentile of adjacent distances (dynamic)
Mean + k·stddev of adjacent distances
Fixed similarity threshold (e.g. 0.75)

questions.prompt: What does the sfl_tag job store per child, and where does it show?
questions.recommendedAnswer: It reuses the existing SFLEngine (spaCy pass 1 plus a DSPy pass 2 for mood, modality and tenor), stores the result per child, and shows it on an [s]fl toggle in the Ingest detail pane. The check-worthiness gate uses SFL mood/modality when available and falls back to spaCy features otherwise.

options.label: Reuse the existing SFLEngine; persist output per child
Show it as an [s]fl toggle in the Ingest detail pane
Fact-check gate prefers SFL mood/modality when present
Also show SFL mood/modality as a column in the Fact-check claims list

questions.prompt: How should tests cover the Redis job store?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add the redis client to an extra (tui/server) and fakeredis to dev. Unit tests run against fakeredis; one opt-in integration test runs against the real local Redis under a unique nblm:test:<uuid> prefix and cleans up only that prefix.

options.label: fakeredis for unit tests + opt-in live-Redis test under a test prefix
fakeredis only
Live Redis only

questions.prompt: Confirm what stays out of scope for this goal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: The Substack channel/persona audio/articles, the other chunking strategies, moving the Compiler/Assessment views onto the job queue beyond what fits naturally, and a web UI.
